SKS WEDDING PLANNERS LOGO
=========================

Place your logo image in THIS folder (`frontend/public/`) and name it exactly:

	SKS.png

=> final path:  frontend/public/SKS.png

Vite serves everything inside `public/` at the site root, so the homepage
3D Gold Coin will automatically load it from the URL:

	/SKS.png

No rebuild needed while running the dev server — just refresh the browser.

If the file is missing, the coin gracefully falls back to a procedural
engraved-gold "SKS" texture so the page never breaks.
